the study of plant growth-promoting traits of Streptomyce spp. and their effect on growth, yield and nutrient uptake of sorghum under field and greenhouse conditions.
the study of the effects of Streptomyce spp. strains in sorghum plants.
the isolation of endophytic Streptomyces from the rhizosphere of sorghum and their evaluation as plant growth-promoting agents in the same host.
